· RSI trajectory (50.5→56.7) + Staying in neutral zone, maintaining upward momentum after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0161→-0.0115) + Diagnosed as improving, potential signal for exiting bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $1.39) + Bandwidth at 9.70%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) + Support confirmed based on SMA5.
· Swing resistance ($1.47) + Potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + Exploring directional movement.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.95x) + Increased confidence in price movement, expecting buying pressure upon directional confirmation.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Buy on confirmation of $1.38 support, specify conditions for additional buying upon breaking $1.47 resistance.
